You get +1[icon:attack] for each other card you have with a "+" symbol in its attack icon.

This Mastermind [keyword:Transforms].

cards.name: Darren Cross

Always Leads: Cross Technologies
Master Strike: Darren Cross [keyword:Double-Crosses] each player. Then he [keyword:Transforms].

cards.name: Protect My Investments
abilities: Fight: If the Bank is empty, each other player chooses a Villain worth 2[icon:vp] or more from their Victory Pile. You choose one of those Villains to enter the Bank.
This Mastermind [keyword:Transforms].

cards.name: Shrinking Research Budget
abilities: Fight: Each Hero currently in the HQ that has no [keyword:Size-Changing] abilities gains [keyword:Size-Changing] for one of its Hero Classes.
This Mastermind [keyword:Transforms].

cards.name: Steal Pym Particles
abilities: Fight: Each other player shuffles a [hc:covert], [hc:tech], or [keyword:Size-Changing] card from their hand or discard pile into the Hero Deck.
This Mastermind [keyword:Transforms].

cards.name: Yellowjacket
abilities: [keyword:Microscopic Size-Changing] [hc:tech][hc:tech]
Master Strike: Each player discards a [hc:instinct] Hero or [keyword:Size-Changing] Hero or gains a Wound. Yellowjacket [keyword:Transforms].

cards.name: Draining Quantum Energy Chamber
abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and KOs one of their cards that shares a Hero Class with any of Ghost's Kidnapped Victims.
Ghost [keyword:Transforms].

cards.name: Elaborate Rescue Plan
abilities: Fight: You may choose a player to gain one of Ghost's Kidnapped Victims.
Ghost [keyword:Transforms].

cards.name: Ghost, Intangible
abilities: You can't fight Ghost unless you made at least 6[icon:recruit] this turn.
Master Strike: Each player discards a [hc:covert] Hero or puts a non-grey Hero from their hand or discard pile next to Ghost as a “Kidnapped Victim.“ Ghost [keyword:Transforms].

cards.name: Ghost, Master Thief
abilities: Ghost gets +1[icon:attack] for each different cost among her “Kidnapped Victimis.“ While this side is face up, you may recruit cards from her Kidnapped Victims (in any order), spending 2[icon:recruit] extra for each.
Always Leads: Ghost Chasers
Master Strike: Each player reveals a [hc:instinct] Hero or discards two cards with [icon:recruit] icons. Ghost [keyword:Transforms].

cards.name: Nightmarish Wraith
abilities: Fight: Each other player puts a non-grey Hero from their discard pile next to Ghost as a Kidnapped Victim.
Ghost [keyword:Transforms].

cards.name: Shadowy Abduction
abilities: Fight: Put the highest cost Hero from the HQ next to Ghost as a Kidnapped Victim.
Ghost [keyword:Transforms].

cards.name: Conqueror's Wrath
abilities: Fight: If there are any Villains in the Rooftops, Streets, and/or Bridge, each player gains a Wound. If there are any Villains in the Multiverse, each player gains a Wound.
Kang [keyword:Transforms].

cards.name: Kang, Multiverse Conqueror
abilities: [keyword:Multiverse Conqueror 8]
While either side of Kang is face up, the “Multiverse“ is a space to his left that can hold multiple Villains. You can fight them (in any order) only while this side is face up.

Master Strike: If there are any Villains in the Multiverse, each player gains a Wound. Then a Villain from the Multiverse enters an empty space among the Rooftops, Streets or Bridge. Kang [keyword:Transforms].

cards.name: Kang, Quantum Conqueror
abilities: [keyword:Rooftops Conqueror 3, Streets Conqueror 3, Bridge Conqueror 3]
Always Leads: Armada of Kang. Set aside the Villains from an extra Villain Group as “Timeline Variants.“
Master Strike: Each player discards a [hc:strength] Hero or gains a Wound. Put a random Timeline Variant Villain face up in the “Multiverse“ space. Kang [keyword:Transforms].

cards.name: Kang's Defiance
abilities: Fight: If any of the Rooftops, Streets, or Bridge are empty, reveal the top card of the Villain Deck. If it's a Villain, it enters one of those spaces.
Put a random Timeline Variant Villain face up in the “Multiverse“ space.
Kang [keyword:Transforms].

cards.name: Multiversal Engine Core
abilities: Fight: Kang [keyword:Double-Crosses] each other player.
Put a random Timeline Variant Villain face up in the “Multiverse“ space.
Kang [keyword:Transforms].

cards.name: The Time Sphere
abilities: Fight: Each other player puts two cards from their hand on the bottom of their deck. You draw two cards.
Kang [keyword:Transforms].

cards.name: Auction Shrink Tech to Highest Bidder
abilities: Setup: 11 Twists. Set aside all 14 cards of a random extra Hero that has any [keyword:Size-Changing] cards as “Shrink Tech.“

Twist: Stack this Twist next to the Scheme as a “Hostile Bid.“ Reveal a random Hero from the Shrink Tech. This turn you may recruit that Hero, but it costs 1[icon:recruit] more for each Hostile Bid. If you recruit it, either KO that Hero or choose any player to gain it. If you don't recruit it by the end of this turn, stack it next to the Scheme as “Controlled by Arms Dealers.“
Evil Wins: When 8 Shrink Tech cards are Controlled by Arms Dealers.

cards.name: Escape an Imprisoning Dimension
abilities: Setup: 5 Twists.
Special Rules: During your turn, any number of times, you may spend 1[icon:attack] to “Seal“ an unsealed city space or unsealed Mastermind space by putting a card above it from the Wound Stack.

Twist: If any city space with a Villain in it or the Mastermind space is not “sealed,“ stack this Twist next to the Mastermind as a “Discovered Escape Route.“ Otherwise, return 3 Seals from above spaces to the Wound Deck, shuffle this Twist into the Villain Deck, and play another card from the Villain Deck.
Evil Wins: When 3 Escape Routes have been discovered.

cards.name: Safeguard Dark Secrets
abilities: Setup: 5 Twists.
Twist: Stack this Twist next to the Mastermind as a “Secret,“ then play another card from the Villain Deck.
Special Rules: You have the ability “[keyword:Heist]: You get +1[icon:recruit]. Shuffle a Secret from next to the Mastermind into the Villain Deck.“
Evil Wins: When the Mastermind has 5 Secrets.

cards.name: Siphon Energy from the Quantum Realm
abilities: Setup: 9 Twists. Set aside the “Quantum Realm“ Villain Group as an extra group. Shuffle its Ambush Scheme into the Villain Deck.

Twist: Stack this Twist next to the Mastermind as a “Quantum Siphon.“ Put a random set aside Quantum Realm Villain on the Siphons. Do its Ambush effect. If there was already a Quantum Realm Villain on the Siphons, KO It.
Special Rules: You may fight Villains on the Quantum Siphons. They get +1[icon:attack] for each two Siphons.
Evil Wins: When 4 Quantum Realm Villains have been KO'd or there are 9 Quantum Siphons.

cards.name: Build a Conquering Army
abilities: Ambush: If the Bridge is empty, move a Villain to the Bridge. Choose an unused Henchman Group and stack Henchmen from it next to this Scheme equal to the number of players.
Special Rules: Players may fight Henchmen stacked here. While here, those Henchmen also have “[keyword:Bridge Conqueror 1].“ If you defeat the last Henchman here, defeat this Scheme.

Twist: Stack another of those Henchmen next to this Scheme (from a Victory Pile if necessary). Then, if there are two more Henchmen here than the number of players: Each player gains a Wound, 3 of those Henchmen enter the city, and you KO this Scheme and the rest of those Henchmen.

cards.name: City Defense System
abilities: [keyword:Streets Conqueror 2]
Ambush: Each player reveals a [hc:ranged] Hero or gains a Wound. [effect:reveal-or-wound:hc:ranged]
Escape: Same effect. [effect:reveal-or-wound:hc:ranged]

cards.name: Energy Shield
abilities: [keyword:Streets Conqueror 2]
Ambush: Put this Energy Shield above the Mastermind space. While it's there, you can't fight the Mastermind. (You can still fight the Energy Shield.)

cards.name: Lord Krylar's Yacht
abilities: Ambush: You may say “I'm sure we can trust Lord Krylar...“ If you do: Draw a card, reveal it, and if it has an odd numbered cost, Lord Krylar [keyword:Double-Crosses] each player.
Fight: Same effect.
Escape: Same effect.

cards.name: M.O.D.O.K.
abilities: [keyword:Microscopic Size-Changing] [hc:ranged][hc:ranged][hc:ranged][hc:ranged]
Ambush: M.O.D.O.K. [keyword:Double-Crosses] each player.
Fight: Each player KOs one of their Heroes. [effect:koHeroEachPlayer]

cards.name: Pursuit Craft
abilities: [keyword:Rooftops Conqueror 2]
Ambush: (After this enters the city) If other Villains or the Mastermind have Conqueror abilities naming any empty city spaces, Pursuit Craft moves to one of those city spaces.

cards.name: Quantumnaut Elite
abilities: [keyword:Rooftops Conqueror 2]
[keyword:Streets Conqueror 2]
Fight: KO two of your Heroes.

cards.name: Troop Ships of Kang
abilities: [keyword:Rooftops Conqueror 2]
Ambush: A Villain worth 2[icon:vp] or 3[icon:vp] from any player's Victory Pile enters the city.

cards.name: Cross' Security Detail
abilities: While the back side of a Mastermind card is face up, this Villain gets +2[icon:attack] and “Escape: Each player discards a card.“
Fight: KO one of your Heroes. [effect:koHeroCurrentPlayer]

cards.name: Hydra Arms Dealer
abilities: Fight: You get +2[icon:recruit], usable only to recruit Heroes with an [icon:attack] icon.

cards.name: Shrinksperiments
abilities: [keyword:Size-Changing] [hc:tech]
Fight: A Hero in the HQ loses all [keyword:Size-Changing] abilities, then gains [keyword:Size-Changing] [hc:tech] this turn. [effect:hq-hero-gains-size-changing:replace:tech]

cards.name: Take Over Pym Technologies
abilities: Ambush: This Scheme captures Bystanders equal to the number of players plus 1, as “Pym Tech Scientists.“

Special Rules: Once per turn, you may pay 3[icon:recruit] or discard a card with [keyword:Size-Changing]. If you do, rescue a Pym Tech Scientist and draw a card. If you rescue the last Scientist, defeat this Scheme.
Twist: This captures another Pym Tech Scientist. Then, if it has 3 or more Scientists, each player discards a card.

cards.name: Yellowjacket Prototype
abilities: [keyword:Microscopic Size-Changing] [hc:instinct][hc:instinct][hc:instinct][hc:instinct]
Ambush: Each player reveals a [hc:instinct] Hero or gains a Wound. [effect:reveal-or-wound:hc:instinct]
Escape: Same effect. [effect:reveal-or-wound:hc:instinct]

cards.name: Anitolov
abilities: Fight: [keyword:Heist]: You may KO up to two of your Heroes.

cards.name: Corrupted Government Agents
abilities: Ambush: Corrupted Government Agents [keyword:Double-Cross] each player.
Fight: You may look at the top three cards of any deck and put them back in any order.

cards.name: Dr. Bill Foster
abilities: To fight Dr. Bill Foster, you must solve a math equation: Discard three cards such that the costs of two of them add up to the cost of the third. They can't all cost 0.
Escape: Each player discards a card that costs 0.

cards.name: Goliath
abilities: [keyword:Size-Changing] [hc:strength]
Ambush: Goliath [keyword:Double-Crosses] each player.
Fight: Goliath topples over, crushing another Villain. You may defeat a Villain that has 4[icon:attack] or less in an adjacent city space.

cards.name: High-Speed Car Chase
abilities: Ambush: Stack 2 cards from the Wound Deck next to this Scheme as “Dangerous Stunts.“

Twist: If there is a Villain in the Streets: Add 2 Dangerous Stunts. Then if there are at least 5 Stunts, there is a “car crash“: Each player gains one of the Stunts as a Wound. KO the rest of the Stunts and this Scheme.
Otherwise: Return a Dangerous Stunt to the Wound Deck. If there are still Stunts here, move a Villain to the Streets. If there aren't any Stunts, defeat this Scheme.

cards.name: Sonny Burch
abilities: Ambush: Sonny Burch [keyword:Double-Crosses] each player.
Fight: [keyword:Heist]: You may choose a player to gain a [hc:tech] or [hc:ranged] Hero from the HQ.

cards.name: Sonny Burch's Goons
abilities: Fight: [keyword:Heist]: You get +2[icon:recruit].

cards.name: Uzman, with Truth Serum
abilities: Fight: Look at the top card of the Hero Deck and claim a Hero Class it has. Choose another player to guess “Truth“ or “Lie.“ If they guessed right, they either KO that Hero or choose a player to gain it. If they guessed wrong, you decide what to do with that Hero Instead. (In solo, you just decide.)

cards.name: Axiam Maitre D'
abilities: Fight: [keyword:Explore]. The Found Hero costs 2 less to recruit this turn.

cards.name: Axian Bartender
abilities: Ambush: Any number of times this turn, you may pay 2[icon:recruit] to “buy a refreshment“ and KO a Wound from your hand or from any player's discard pile.
Fight: Same effect.

cards.name: Hungering Energy
abilities: [keyword:Microscopic Size-Changing] [hc:tech][hc:tech][hc:tech][hc:tech]
Fight: KO one of your Heroes. [effect:koHeroCurrentPlayer]

cards.name: Lord Krylar's Appetizer
abilities: [keyword:Microscopic Size-Changing] [hc:covert][hc:covert][hc:covert][hc:covert]
Fight: Choose a player to “eat the appetizer“ and KO a card of their choice from their discard pile.

cards.name: Lord Krylar's Valet
abilities: Fight: [keyword:Explore]. You get +[icon:recruit] equal to the Found Hero's printed [icon:recruit].

cards.name: Quantumania
abilities: Ambush: Each player puts a non-grey Hero from their hand or discard pile next to this Scheme as a “Quantum Duplicate.“ Then do the Twist effect below.
Twist: The top card of the Hero Deck becomes another Quantum Duplicate. Each player reveals their hand and discards all their cards that have the same name as any Quantum Duplicate.

Special Rules: Players may spend [icon:attack] equal to a Quantum Duplicate's printed cost to KO that Hero or choose a player to gain it. When there are no more Quantum Duplicates, defeat this Scheme.

cards.name: Quantumoeba
abilities: [keyword:Microscopic Size-Changing] [hc:strength][hc:strength][hc:strength][hc:strength]
Ambush: Quantumoeba “eats“ a Henchman from any player's Victory Pile, capturing it and gaining its printed [icon:attack].
Fight: Put the eaten Henchman in your Victory Pile and do its Fight effect.

cards.name: Sky Manta
abilities: Fight: [keyword:Explore]. If you recruit the Found Hero this turn, set it aside. When you draw a new hand this turn, add that card to your hand.

cards.name: Time Loop Experiments
abilities: Draw a card. Then put a card from your hand on top of your deck. [keyword:put-hand-on-deck-top:1]
[hc:tech]: [keyword:Woman Out of Time]

cards.name: Borrow from the Future
abilities: Reveal the top card of your deck. If it costs 2 or more, draw it. Otherwise, discard it or put it back.
[hc:ranged]: [keyword:Woman Out of Time]

cards.name: Reprogram Doombot Legions
abilities: [team:fantastic-four]: You may look at the top two cards of your deck. If you do, KO one of them and put the other back.

cards.name: Protege of Dr. Doom
abilities: Use one of Dr. Doom's Mastermind Tactics. You can't use any of them more than once per game. If you have already used them all, get +4[icon:attack] instead.
(Take another turn; or draw three extra cards at end of turn; or you may recruit a [hc:tech] or [hc:ranged] Hero for free; or all other players draw a card or discard a card.)

cards.name: Human Torch
abilities: [keyword:Focus] 2[icon:recruit] [icon:5] KO up to two Wounds from your hand and/or discard pile.
[keyword:Focus] 6[icon:recruit] [icon:5] You get +6[icon:attack] and gain a Wound.

cards.name: Thing
abilities: [team:fantastic-four]: You get +1[icon:recruit].
[keyword:Focus] 3[icon:recruit] [icon:5] You get +2[icon:attack].

cards.name: Invisible Woman
abilities: If you played any other cards that cost 4 this turn, you get +2[icon:recruit].
[keyword:Focus] 4[icon:recruit] [icon:5] Rescue a Bystander, then you may KO a card from your hand or discard pile.

cards.name: Mr. Fantastic
abilities: Draw two cards. [keyword:draw:2]
[keyword:Focus] 5[icon:recruit] [icon:5] You get +7[icon:attack] usable only against the Mastermind.

cards.name: Firelord
abilities: This turn, your Heroes' Conqueror abilities also give you [icon:attack] if those city spaces have been destroyed.
[hc:ranged]: [keyword:Bridge Conqueror 2]

cards.name: Silver Surfer
abilities: [keyword:Focus] 2[icon:recruit] [icon:5] Draw a card, then you may move a Villain to an adjacent city space. If another Villain is already there, swap them.

cards.name: Stardust
abilities: [keyword:Focus] 4[icon:recruit] [icon:5] [keyword:Rooftops Conqueror 4]
[keyword:Focus] 11[icon:recruit] [icon:5] Search the Hero Deck, HQ, or your deck or discard pile for “Galactus Hungers“ and put it on top of your deck. Shuffle any deck you searched.

cards.name: Galactus Hungers
abilities: If you have played another Herald of Galactus this turn, destroy the leftmost city space, defeat any Villain there, and then you get +2[icon:attack] for each destroyed city space. If this destroys the last city space, Galactus consumes the Earth. You Win, Evil Wins, and all other players lose.

cards.name: Avert Future Tragedy
abilities: [keyword:Focus] 2[icon:recruit] [icon:5] Reveal the top card of the Villain Deck. If it's a Master Strike, you get +3[icon:attack], KO it, and replace it with the top card from the Bystander Stack.
[hc:instinct]: [keyword:Man/Woman Out of Time]

cards.name: Interdimensional Rescue
abilities: [keyword:Focus] 1[icon:recruit] [icon:5] Reveal the top card of the Villain Deck. If it's a Bystander, you get +2[icon:attack], rescue it, and shuffle the top card from the Bystander Stack into the Villain Deck.
[hc:covert]: [keyword:Man/Woman Out of Time]

cards.name: Slip the Timestream
abilities: [keyword:Focus] 1[icon:recruit] [icon:5] Reveal the top card of the Villain Deck. If it's a Villain, you get +1[icon:attack] and you may fight it this turn.
[hc:instinct][hc:covert]: [keyword:Man/Woman Out of Time]

cards.name: Reshape Reality
abilities: [keyword:Focus] 3[icon:recruit] [icon:5] Reveal the top card of the Villain Deck. If it's a Scheme Twist, you get +4[icon:attack] and shuffle the Villain Deck.
[team:fantastic-four][team:fantastic-four]: [keyword:Man/Woman Out of Time]

cards.name: Stretching Credibility
abilities: [keyword:Focus] 2[icon:attack] [icon:5] When you draw a new hand of cards at the end of this turn, draw an extra card.

cards.name: Rock Solid
abilities: [hc:strength]: [keyword:Sewers Conqueror 1]
[keyword:Focus] 3[icon:attack] [icon:5] You get +2[icon:recruit].

cards.name: Transparent Motives
abilities: [keyword:Bank Conqueror 1]
[keyword:Focus] 3[icon:attack] [icon:5] You may KO a card from your hand or discard pile.

cards.name: Put to the Torch
abilities: [keyword:Bridge Conqueror 1]
[keyword:Streets Conqueror 1]
You may gain a Wound. If you do, you get [keyword:Rooftops Conqueror 4]. [keyword:gain-wound-reward:rooftops-conqueror:4]

cards.name: Annihilus
abilities: Always Leads: Annihilation Wave (1 player: Use 6 Henchmen.)

Master Strike: Reveal the top card of the Villain Deck. If it's a Bystander, Annihilus captures it. If it's a Villain, it enters the city, captures a Bystander, and moves forward an extra space (before doing any Ambush ability).

cards.name: Deploy the Planet Killer
abilities: Fight: If this is not the final tactic: if Weaponized Galactus is in the city, he escapes. If Weaponized Galactus wasn't in the city and wasn't in any victory pile, then he enters the city from the Villain Deck and you shuffle the Villain Deck.

cards.name: Epic Annihilus
abilities: Always Leads: Annihilation Wave. Add an extra Villain Group (even for 1 player.)
Master Strike: Play a card from the Villain Deck. If it's a Villain, play a second card from the Villain Deck.

cards.name: Pull Into the Negative Zone
abilities: Fight: The cost of each hero currently in the HQ gets -2 this turn.

cards.name: Surging Annihilation
abilities: Fight: Check all Annihilation Wave villains from each other player's victory pile. The one worth the most VP enters the city, and that player rescues bystanders equal to that villain's VP.

cards.name: The Cosmic Control Rod
abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals the top three cards of their deck, KOs the highest-cost Hero that is revealed this way and puts the rest back in any order.

cards.name: Epic Kang the Conqueror
abilities: Kang has [keyword:Conqueror 3] for each city space under a Time Incursion. Villains under a Time Incursion get +3[icon:attack].
Always Leads: Timelines of Kang

Master Strike: This Strike becomes a “Time Incursion.“ Put it above the rightmost city space that doesn't yet have a Time Incursion. If there are any Villains in any Time Incursions, each player gains a Wound.

cards.name: Iron Lad Grows Up to Become Kang
abilities: Fight: If this is not the final Tactic: Each player reveals their hand. You choose a card named “Iron Lad“ from the Escape Pile, or from [keyword:Man Out of Time], or from any player's hand or discard pile or that you played this turn. Shuffle Iron Lad into Kang's Tactics as a Mastermind Tactic that says “Fight: Gain this as a Hero.“

cards.name: Kang the Conqueror
abilities: Kang has [keyword:Conqueror 2] for each city space under a Time Incursion. (He benefits from Villains there.) Villains under a Time Incursion get +2[icon:attack].
Always Leads: Timelines of Kang
Master Strike: This Strike becomes a “Time Incursion.“ Put it above the rightmost city space that doesn't yet have a Time Incursion.

cards.name: Leap Into the Timestream
abilities: Fight: If this is not the final Tactic: Take another turn after this one. Don't play a card from the Villain Deck at the start of that turn.

cards.name: Pull From the Future
abilities: Fight: Reveal the top two cards of the Villain Deck. Choose a Villain revealed this way to enter an empty city space under a Time Incursion. Put the rest back in any order.

cards.name: Savior From Another Timeline
abilities: Fight: You may gain a Hero from any HQ space under a Time Incurion. Send it as a [keyword:Man or Woman Out of Time].

cards.name: Breach Parallel Dimensions
abilities: Setup: 6 Twists. Add 4 extra Bystanders to the Villain Deck. Deal the shuffled Villain Deck into several “Dimension“ decks where the first Dimension has 1 card, the next has 2 cards, then 3, 4, etc. (The final Dimension might not have enough cards to reach its full number.)

Special Rules: Each turn, you choose which Dimension you play a card from. All players have “[keyword:Focus 1][icon:recruit]  [icon:5] Reveal the top card of any Dimension and put it back on the top or bottom of that deck.“ If a Dimension ever has no cards left, even in the middle of a card ability, it is destroyed. Mark it with a face up Wound.
Twist: Choose a Dimension and play two cards from it. (It's ok if it only has 1.)
Evil Wins: When at least half of the original Dimensions are destroyed.

cards.name: Pulse Waves From the Negative Zone
abilities: Setup: 9 Twists.
Twist 1,3,5,7: “Negative Pulse“: This turn, Heroes in the HQ cost -1[icon:recruit] and Villains and Masterminds get -1[icon:attack].
Twist 2,4,6,8: “Positive Pulse“: This turn, Heroes in the HQ cost +1[icon:recruit] and Villains and Masterminds get +1[icon:attack].
Twist 9: Evil wins!

cards.name: Put Humanity on Trial
abilities: Setup: 11 Twists. Stack 11 Bystanders next to the Scheme face down as “Galactic Jurors.“

Special Rules: Each Twist gives you a challenge to achieve this turn. If you do it, you have convinced a Juror, and you rescue them. If you don't, put that Juror face up next to the Villain Deck, voting to condmen Humanity.
Twist 1-2: “Opening Arguments“: Discard three cards with different names.
Twist 3,5,7: “Question Witnesses“: Recruit a Hero that costs 5 or more.
Twist 4,6,8: “Introduce Evidence“: Defeat Villain(s) worth 3VP or more.
Twist 9-11: “Closing Arguments“: Defeat the Mastermind.
Evil Wins: When 6 Jurors vote to Condmen Humanity.

cards.name: Sneak Attack the Heroes' Homes
abilities: Setup: 6 Twists. Each player chooses a Hero to be part of the Hero Deck. Randomly select other Heroes up to the normal number of Heroes. Each player adds to their starting deck three non-rare cards with different names from the Hero they chose and three Wounds.
Twist 1-5: Each player discards a non-grey Hero or gains a Wound.
Twist 6: Evil Wins!

cards.name: Annihilation Armada
abilities: Ambush: A Henchmen Villain from your Victory Pile enters the city.

cards.name: Queens of Annihilation
abilities: Ambush: Reveal the top card of the Villain Deck. If it's a Villain, play it.
Fight: KO one of your Heroes. [effect:koHeroCurrentPlayer]

cards.name: Ravenous
abilities: Ambush: Ravenous swaps places with an Annihilation Wave Villain that isn't Weaponized Galactus.
Escape: Each player reveals a [hc:strength] Hero or gains a wound. [effect:reveal-or-wound:hc:strength]

cards.name: Weaponized Galactus
abilities: Ambush: Weaponized Galactus swaps places with the leftmost Villain in the city.

Escape: Destroy the leftmost city space. If this destroys the last city space, Evil Wins. Otherwise, each player gains a Wound, and you shuffle Weaponized Galactus back into the Villain Deck. Any Villain from the destroyed city space escapes.

cards.name: Immortus

If you recruit it, either KO that Hero or choose any player to gain it. If you don't recruit it by the end of this turn, stack it next to the Scheme as “Controlled by Arms Dealers.“

Twist 5-11: Destroy the rightmost TV show and the HQ space beneath it. KO any Hero in that HQ space. Push forward any Villain there. Move the Villain Deck & Hero Deck to mark the city's right edge.
Evil Wins: When all TV is destroyed.

Setup: 11 Twists. Use 4 Heroes in the Hero Deck, plus 4 other Heroes to make a ”Past Hero Deck.” Above the board, make room for an alternate city called ”The Past.” It has the normal 5 spaces, from Sewers to Bridge. The Past has its own ”Past HQ” filled by the ”Past Hero Deck.” To start, play as if ”The Past” city, HQ, and Hero Deck don't exist.

Twist 1,3,5,7,9: Until the next Twist, move the Villain Deck next to ”The Past,” and play as if ”The Past” city, HQ, and Hero Deck exist, while the normal city, HQ, and Hero Deck don't exist. (Use the normal decks and spaces for everything except the city, HQ, and Hero Deck.)
Twist 10: Evil wins!

Setup: 11 Twists.

Twist 1-6: Stack the top two cards of the [rule:Sidekick] Stack face down next to the Scheme as “Kidnapped Mutants.“ If there were any Kidnapped Mutants already there, put those on the bottom of the [rule:Sidekick] Stack and put this Twist next to the Mastermind as a “Drained Power.“

Setup: 9 Twists.

schemes.name: Trash Earth with Hugest Party Ever

abilities: Setup: 6 Twists. Always include the Party Thor Hero and Intergalactic Part Animals Villain Group.

Twist: If Frigga, Mother of Thor, is in play, stack this Twist next to the Scheme as “Discovered Wreckage.“ Otherwise: Search the Villain Deck for Frigga and she does her Ambush ability. Then shuffle this Twist back into the Villain Deck.
Special Rules: You can't fight or defeat Frigga.
Evil Wins: When 5 Wreckages have been Discovered.
Setup: 4 Twists. Include exactly one Villain Group with “[keyword:Rise of The Living Dead].“ Add 8 random cards from an extra Hero to the Villain Deck. 1-2 players: Add 3 Bystanders.

Special Rules: Hero cards from the Villain Deck are “Zombie“ Villains with [icon:attack] equal to their cost +1, worth VP equal to their cost. They have “Ambush: [keyword:Rise of The Living Dead]. Fight: Play a copy of this card as a Hero, then put it into your Victory Pile as a Villain“ (it still has [keyword:Rise].)
Twist: Each villain in the city with “Rise of the Living Dead“ escapes. Then play another card from the Villain Deck.
Evil Wins: When there are 3 Villains per player in the Escape Pile or the Villain Deck runs out.
Setup: 11 Twists

Twist: Each player reveals their hand. Starting with the current player, then clockwise, the first player to have one of this kind of Hero in their hand or discard pile stacks it next to this scheme, “stolen for the Zoo.“
Twist 1: [hc:strength] T2: [hc:instinct] T3: [hc:covert] T4: [hc:tech] T5: [hc:ranged] T6: 5-cost. T7: 4-cost. T8: 3-cost. T9: 0-cost. T10: [icon:recruit] icon. T11: [icon:attack] icon.
Evil Wins: When the Zoo has 5 heroes.

schemes.name: Breach the Nexus of All Realities

abilities: Setup: (1-2 players: Use 3 Villain Groups.) Stack each Villain Group seperately face down as its own “Reality.“ Add 2 Twists to each Reality. Shuffle together all the Henchmen, Master Strikes, and Bystanders for your player count and randomly distribute them amongst all the Realities, as evenly as possible. Shuffle each Reality seperately.
Special Rules: Each turn, you choose which Reality (Villain Deck) plays a card. They all play into the same city.
Twist: Stack this Twist next to this Reality as a “Dimensional Breach.“ If this was the second Breach for that Reality, destory that Reality, KO'ing all its cards.
Evil Wins: When all Realities have been destroyed.
When you rescue this Bystander, reveal the top card of the Villain Deck. If it's a Master Strike or Scheme Twist, you may shuffle that deck.
When you rescue this Bystander, reveal the top four cards of your deck. Draw each [hc:tech] and [hc:ranged] Hero you revealed. Put the rest back in any order.
When you rescue this Bystander, reveal the top four cards of the Bystander Deck. You may rescue a Special Bystander from among them, then put the rest back on the bottom of that deck.
When you rescue this Bystander, you get +1[icon:recruit] if the Bank is empty and +1[icon:recruit] if the Rooftops are empty.
When you rescue this Bystander, whichever player is a head (has the most VP or tied for most) may KO one of their cards.
Healing: If you don't recruit or fight anything on your turn, you may KO all the Wounds from your hand.
